title: Custom Settings: Turn a Content Type Into Site Settings | Orchard Core
description:
Some values belong to the whole site, such as an announcement or a contact address. They do not fit in a page, and an editor needs a form to change them.

The Custom Settings feature turns a content type into a section of the Settings menu. The fields of the type become the form, the values are saved with the site settings, and each section has a permission of its own.

In this video:
• What Custom Settings are
• Enabling the feature
• Creating the content type, its fields and its stereotype
• Editing the settings
• Controlling who can edit a section
• Moving settings to another site with a deployment plan
